title: Normalization from .csv
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare normalization CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file that lists each transfer with the columns: source plate well, destination plate well, volume sample (µl), volume diluent (µl). Include the header line and ignore empty lines. Example line: A1, A1, 2, 28. An example file can be downloaded from the provided link.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Eppendorf™ 96‑Well twin.tec™ PCR Plate 250 µl; NEST 12‑channel reservoir 15 ml (or USA Scientific 12‑Well Reservoir 22 ml); Opentrons 20 µl tiprack and 300 µl tiprack; Opentrons P20 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Place reservoir on deck
steps.instruction: Load the NEST 12‑channel reservoir into slot 1 of the OT‑2 deck and fill channel 1 with water for dilution.

steps.title: Load CSV and set mount sides
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the normalization .csv file and specify the mount sides for the P10 and P50 GEN1 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol script to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing all labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tipracks, and the pipettes. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the normalization procedure.
